value.rationale: The two-hop horizon is the smallest nontrivial directed routing depth, and all marked request-overlap types admit a unified exact sign classification. The strict negative finite-horizon chain correlation contrasts with the established positive unrestricted-path regime, identifying long-range paths as necessary for the counter-intuitive sign reversal. This is an interpretable local-versus-global boundary rather than an arbitrary slice or a mere small-n recomputation.
